title: Sessions: Run opens a tab, Run once leaves the saved session alone
covers: Run, Go to its tab, Run once, Save and run, session tab opening
context: Run on Sessions opens the session as a tab on the main window and closes the Sessions screen. A session that already has a tab reads Go to its tab. Run once with these changes uses your unsaved changes for one run and never writes the saved session. Save and run saves first.
changed: ap:sessions:start with the session id and the allowed overrides

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: state
setup.text: The session Setup check of the previous test, or any saved session with one player of A Link to the Past.

steps: The Sessions screen closes and the main window shows a tab named Setup check, with a status dot and the stage header: name, Lobby, Where, a session code with a copy button, and the buttons Edit setup, Close lobby and Run.

Open Sessions again and pick Setup check. The button reads Go to its tab, and a note says the session has an open tab and that Where and direct connections change once you close its lobby. Press Go to its tab: the tab comes to the front.
Close the tab (the x on the tab, or Close in its context menu). No question is asked, because nobody joined. In Sessions the button reads Run again.
Change a world setting, for example the hint cos The header reads 1 uns Press Run once with these changes A new tab opens Beside the status a tag reads 1 change from s
Hover it: the list names the setting, the saved value and the value it runs with.
Open Sessions and pick Setup check. The setting still has the old value, and the form is back to the saved session. Run once did not write it.
Change the name. Run once with these changes is greyed out with the reason: The name, Where and the password change only with Save and run.
Press Save and run. The session is saved with the new name and its tab opens under that name. Close the open tabs when you are done.
pass: Run opens a tab and closes the Sessions screen. A session with a tab reads Go to its tab.
Run once uses the changes for one run, shows the tag n changes from saved on the tab, and leaves the saved session as it was.
The name, Where and the password cannot be changed with Run once. Save and run saves first.
fail: Run stays on the Sessions screen, or a second tab opens for a session that already has one.
Run once writes the change into the saved session, or the tag is missing.
Run once is allowed with a changed name, Where or password.
notes: The chip on the tab is hidden when the run matches the saved session.
The tab itself, its seats and the room are in the next tests.
